svg.title: Clathrin-mediated endocytosis
svg.desc: Original conceptual mammalian pathway. Editable lipid bilayers, receptors, cargo, AP2, clathrin and dynamin. Cargo remains lumenal; coat proteins are cytosolic. Selected factors shown, not to scale.

text.data-label: Cargo capture, membrane scission and coat removal

svg.text: Cargo capture, membrane scission and coat removal

text.data-label: Cargo stays in the lumen; coat assembly and removal occur on the cytosolic surface.
